`Ledger.post` in `ledger/entries.py` now emits one INFO record on the `ledger` logger for each posted entry. I ran `python -m pytest -q` and all 4 tests pass. `brief check` reports no governance violations. I didn't run `brief pin` or `brief doctor`.

The record reads `posted entry account=<redacted> amount_cents=<n>`. The amount is logged as integer cents.

The account is masked with `redact()`, which keeps only the last 4 characters. The project's `logs-redact-account-ids` decision requires this, so I followed it over the remembered note about logging raw account ids. It also puts a `// Context:` ref to that decision next to the log line.

I added `logs-redact-account-ids conforms: ...` to `.brief/SIGNOFF` for that decision. Nothing is committed.
signoff: logs-redact-account-ids conforms: Ledger.post logs the account via redact(), never the raw id
